title: Llegada
subtitle: Arrival
premise: You've just landed at Barajas airport. Your bag didn't arrive. You need to find the lost luggage office, but the signs are confusing and your phone is dead.
setting: Madrid Barajas International Airport, Terminal 4, baggage claim area. The carousel is empty. Other passengers have gone. You stand there alone.

characters.name: Elena
characters.personality: Efficient, slightly impatient, but kind when she realizes you're struggling

characters.name: Miguel
characters.role: A fellow passenger who sees you struggling
characters.personality: Friendly, patient, speaks slowly when he sees you don't understand

arc: Confusion at empty carousel → Elena notices you → Misunderstanding about your bag → Miguel steps in to help → Office visit together → Case resolved, first connection made
